text: The two legacy criteria of RWB-E4-049 are kept word for word and are tested on a synthetic set of this run: case RC-2026-000555 with receipt PR-2026-000555 of source CUSTOMER for 12,500.00 THB on the business date, applied to the balance of the case. The detail behind the generic legacy lines is filled from FSD P8 A2.10 and TSD P8, the legacy test case IDs keep their own rows in the Test Cases master, and the contract slice owns none of the criteria.
why: The legacy criteria and their four test cases name no receipt, amount, case or date, the FSD main success criterion is one line marked Written one epic ahead, and the story cannot be built or tested without a stated data set.

text: The application order is read as one rule row of the PAYMENT_MATCH package at the version in force, with the receipt amount, the balance components and the business date as inputs; the order, its components, its percentages and its caps are never values of the build; the applied state value of the proceeds row is the one fixed by the DB story; and the JOB-07 run and its application activity carry a placeholder name until the Temporal Workflow and Activity Catalog publishes one.
why: No source publishes the application order, its components or its caps, the package code and rule IDs of the application, the applied state value or the names of the run and the activity, and the step cannot be evaluated or asserted without a stated reading.
